test.rule: For each member, the middle-high-bin net outward horizontal term must exceed zero in every fixed box, cutoff scheme, and collocation method. Report the five-member pass count and the east-control baseline upstream sign and value. Preserve each member and every failed case; do not select a favorable member.

boundary: Sign variation across members indicates sensitivity within one assimilative ORAS5 product. Agreement does not establish independent-product replication, a formal uncertainty interval, a persistent physical boundary, or a closed density budget.
